mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market, which historically leads to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when RSAFS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply chain, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, signaling a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200k and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2pp, it signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS MoM > 200k and UNRATE MoM < -0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when HOUST is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is below its 12-month moving average and Real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative, it signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 12-month MA and GDPC1 QoQ < 0%.
